steps.name: assert-handle-per-row
steps.eval: const rows=document.querySelectorAll('.select-option-row'); const handles=document.querySelectorAll('.select-option-row .room-reorder-handle'); if(rows.length===0) throw new Error('no option rows'); if(handles.length!==rows.length) throw new Error('handles '+handles.length+' != rows '+rows.length); 'ok:'+rows.length

steps.name: assert-handle-not-nested
steps.eval: const h=document.querySelector('.room-reorder-handle'); if(!h) throw new Error('no handle'); if(h.closest('[role="option"]')) throw new Error('handle nested inside option button'); 'ok'
